capabilities: Schedule task reminders on Jalali dates
Pick reminder times with a clock-style hour and minute picker
Track tasks in sidebar and dashboard views
Show in-app due alerts with done, snooze and open-note actions
Insert new tasks into daily notes for the selected day
disambiguation: Not a Persian language pack; it is a task reminder plugin with a Persian right-to-left interface.
extras: Alerts are in-app only and depend on Obsidian being open; there is no OS-level notification when the app is closed. The README is bilingual (English and Persian) and includes build, release and bug-report instructions.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in reminders, and Persian-speaking users need Jalali dates and a right-to-left interface to schedule and track tasks.

relations.evidence: It integrates with the Persian Calendar community plugin to select Jalali dates
گزینهٔ «استفاده از قالب Templater» را فعال کنید و قالب روزانه را از فهرست قالب‌ها انتخاب کنید

summary: Persian-language task reminder plugin with Jalali date selection, a clock-style time picker, and sidebar and dashboard task views.
